specs.name: Chiikawa / ちいかわ / 치이카와
specs.identity: the FAR LEFT small WHITE round-eared hamster-like character in the official reference. White body, two small round ears, tiny brows, two dark oval eyes with highlights, small two-lobed mouth, pink cheeks. No blue markings, no rabbit ears.

specs.name: Hachiware / ハチワレ / 하치와레
specs.identity: the SECOND character from LEFT in the official reference: WHITE cat with BLUE cap of fur divided by a centered white V, two small triangular blue cat ears, subtle brows, oval eyes and a tiny two-lobed mouth; small blue cat tail. Not a hamster or Usagi.

specs.name: Momonga / モモンガ / 모몽가
specs.identity: the FOURTH character from LEFT in the official reference, immediately after Usagi: WHITE fluffy flying squirrel with blue inner rounded upright ears, tiny BLUE oval nose, expressive dark oval eyes, fluffy cheeks, huge blue-striped fluffy tail behind its body. Keep the distinct blue nose and blue-striped tail. No rabbit ears, not a plain teddy bear.

specs.name: Kurimanju / くりまんじゅう / 쿠리만쥬
specs.identity: the FIFTH character from LEFT in the official reference: PALE CREAM chestnut bun-like character, smooth BROWN dome cap on top of head, NO EXTERNAL EARS, tiny dark oval eyes, understated tiny brows and small closed mouth. No teddy-bear ears! No Usagi mouth, no blue hair. Do not add a cup except when the action requests one.

specs.name: Rakko / ラッコ / 랏코
specs.identity: the fuzzy PALE YELLOW SEA OTTER to the RIGHT of the three armored figures in the official reference. Distinct STAR-SHAPED SCAR on LEFT forehead, short spiky fur tufts along head contour, calm stern oval eyes and tiny muzzle, white hunter cape tied at neck. NOT a brown forehead tuft or blob. Keep the star scar and white cape in every frame. Sword sheathed only except special training.

specs.name: Shisa / シーサー / 시사
specs.identity: the cream guardian-lion immediately RIGHT of Rakko in the official reference: CREAM rounded head and body, small cream pointed floppy ears with warm inner color, ORANGE ruffled fur behind sides of head, distinctive thick pointed ORANGE eyebrows, oval dark eyes, tiny closed two-lobed mouth. NOT orange spiral hair covering whole head, not orange bear ears. Preserve the official orange brows and side ruff.

actions.walk: ONE action: walking toward RIGHT in three-quarter view. Four successive gait frames: left foot forward, legs passing, right foot forward, legs passing. Opposite gentle arm swing. Fixed head orientation and proportions; four distinct leg positions.
actions.sit: ONE action: settling into a sit, facing FRONT. Frame 1 calm neutral standing with both arms lowered; frame 2 knees and body lowering halfway; frame 3 seated resting feet forward and paws on belly; frame 4 seated relaxed, softly blinking. Head stays EXACTLY the same diameter, without zoom.
actions.sleep: ONE action: sleeping curled comfortably, facing FRONT/three-quarter. ALL FOUR frames asleep with eyes closed. Frame1 relaxed exhaled pose; frame2 gentle inhale slight chest expansion; frame3 full inhale slight ear/tail relaxation; frame4 gentle exhale. No text or floating Z. No major pose/scale change.
actions.stretch: ONE action: stretching while standing FRONT. Frame1 arms low ready; frame2 slowly raises both arms halfway; frame3 full gentle stretch both arms up with eyes happily closed; frame4 arms lowering relaxed. Exact same head size and floor baseline, exactly two arms.
actions.jump: ONE action: a small happy hop facing FRONT/three-quarter. Frame1 short crouch, feet on baseline; frame2 legs extend and arms lift as taking off; frame3 airborne happy pose feet tucked; frame4 soft landing knees bent, feet back on baseline. Same head diameter throughout, no drawn trails. Sprite framing stays fixed.
actions.eat: ONE action: eating ONE pizza dumpling. FRONT view, exactly TWO total arms/two hands only. Frame1 holding full dumpling touching mouth, no gap; frame2 one bite removed and chewing, smaller dumpling still at mouth; frame3 tiny final bite touching mouth with eyes closed; frame4 swallowed, empty hands lowered and content expression, NO dumpling left. Food must shrink into mouth, not disappear in belly or float. Never draw spare paws.
actions.stumble: ONE action: mild stumble and recovery facing RIGHT. Frame1 toe catches while leaning slightly forward, worried face; frame2 tips forward and both arms brace; frame3 safely lying on tummy, slightly dazed, no injury; frame4 pushing up from ground to get back on feet. Same head diameter in every pose, exactly two arms, no stars/particles.
actions.held: ONE action: held gently in midair, no human hand drawn. Frame1 left foot kicks and ears tilt left; frame2 opposite foot kicks and ears tilt right; frame3 stopped kicking with mildly sulky/pouting face looking left; frame4 pouting face looking right with one small foot wiggle. Body remains suspended at same center, exactly two arms/two feet. No strings or motion lines.

special.chiikawa: ONE action: shy greeting. Frame1 front standing paws tucked at belly; frame2 peeks sideways timidly with one paw near cheek; frame3 tiny shy wave with one paw; frame4 happy relieved small smile, both paws relaxed. No props.
special.hachiware: ONE action: friendly humming. Frame1 standing smile ready; frame2 mouth forms small singing O and one paw lifts; frame3 happily sings eyes closed, both paws gently out; frame4 closes mouth and settles smiling. No music-note graphics.
special.momonga: ONE action: brief flying-squirrel glide. Frame1 smug crouch tail poised; frame2 small launch arms begin spreading; frame3 arms and little gliding membrane spread, feet tucked, tail extended behind; frame4 gentle landing feet touch ground, proud expression. No trails or particles.
special.kurimanju: ONE action: relaxed sip from a small TEA CUP. Frame1 holds cup below mouth in exactly two hands; frame2 brings cup rim to mouth; frame3 eyes close while taking sip, cup tilted slightly; frame4 cup lowers and a satisfied open-mouth exhale. No alcohol, extra arms, text or clouds.
special.rakko: ONE action: controlled sword practice in empty space, no target or injury. Frame1 noble ready stance paw on hilt; frame2 small controlled wind-up with short practice sword raised; frame3 clean controlled swing, cape follows; frame4 sword lowered safely and proud calm face. Star-shaped forehead scar stays visible. Exactly two arms.
special.shisa: ONE action: polite welcome and serving. Frame1 cheerful front standing palms together; frame2 bows politely; frame3 stands holding one small ramen bowl at belly with exactly two hands; frame4 puts bowl aside (no bowl visible) and gives one cheerful welcome wave. No extra arms.
